subject: gk
question: In India, seasonal unemployment is predominantly associated with which field?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Agriculture**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Agriculture:**

 
 
• Seasonal unemployment is most prevalent in agriculture.
 
• Agricultural activities are dependent on seasonal factors like rainfall and harvesting periods.
 
• During off-seasons, there is significantly less demand for agricultural labor.
 
• Many agricultural workers are employed only during planting and harvesting seasons.
 
• This leads to periods of unemployment for a large portion of the agricultural workforce.
 
 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Surface Transport:**

 
 
• While there can be fluctuations in demand, surface transport generally provides more consistent employment.
 
• Transport services are needed throughout the year.
 
• There might be minor seasonal variations, but they don't result in widespread unemployment like in agriculture.
 
• Modern transport systems are less dependent on seasonal changes.
 
• The transport sector is a very important part of the indian economy.
 
 
 
• **Mining Industry:**
 
 
• The mining industry can be affected by factors like weather and market demand, but it doesn't typically experience the same level of seasonal unemployment as agriculture.
 
• Mining operations tend to be ongoing throughout the year.
 
• There may be some variations due to weather, but not to the same degree as agriculture.
 
• The mining industry is a very important industrial sector.
 
• Mining is less dependent on the weather, than is agriculture.
 
 
 
• **Space and Technology:**
 
 
• The space and technology sector is generally not subject to seasonal variations in employment.
 
• These industries operate on continuous projects and research.
 
• Employment in these fields is driven by technological advancements and project timelines, not seasonal changes.
 
• This is a very stable employment sector.
 
• This sector requires highly skilled workers.
